original.target_description: Experiment 1, Hypothesis 1a: low ($0.50) versus medium ($5.00) cash payment on expected willingness of other students to help load a sofa into a van; planned contrast within the full seven-condition between-participants ANOVA.

n.location: p. 789 (PDF p. 3), Experiment 1 Method; Results footnote 3
n.quote: Six hundred fourteen students at the University of California, Berkeley, and Massachusetts Institute of Technology were approached in a variety of campus locations and asked to complete a brief survey.
n.sample_role: Student participants in the full seven-condition ANOVA underlying the planned contrast; cash-condition-specific sample sizes not printed.
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; printed total agrees with the seven-condition model residual df 607.

es.location: p. 789 (PDF p. 3), Experiment 1 Results and Discussion, Hypothesis 1a
es.quote:
payment level increased from low to medium, F(1, 607) 5 5.03,
p < .001

p.location: p. 789 (PDF p. 3), Experiment 1 Results and Discussion, Hypothesis 1a
p.quote:
payment level increased from low to medium, F(1, 607) 5 5.03,
p < .001

replication.target_description: Study 1, H1a: low-cash versus medium-cash conditions on expected willingness to help load a sofa into a van; planned estimated-marginal-means comparison in the six-condition between-subject ANOVA, Tukey-adjusted p.

n.location: Study 1 Results, Replication, H1a paragraph before Table 3; Results opening paragraph
n.quote: the medium-cash condition (M = 7.15, SD = 2.60, N = 274) was higher than that in the low-cash condition (M = 3.63, SD = 3.02, N = 273)
n.sample_role: Participants in the two cash conditions compared; contrast uses the six-condition ANOVA residual df 1643.
n.exclusions: Following our pre-registration, no data exclusion was performed. Full Study 1 recruitment of 2203 includes eight conditions and is not the sample for this contrast.

es.location: p. 5, Table 4, H1a: low-cash condition vs. medium-cash condition on expected willingness to help, Study 1 row, Cohen’s d (replication) column

p.location: p. 5, Table 4, H1a: low-cash condition vs. medium-cash condition on expected willingness to help, Study 1 row, p column; Study 1 Replication opening paragraph specifies Tukey adjustment

notes: The study label 1a is matched to Hypothesis 1a (cash payment level) in original Experiment 1 and replication Study 1 using the supplied p. 3 and Table 4 locators. Original F and p retained exactly as printed despite their apparent inconsistency; no p recalculation or effect-size conversion performed. PDF text renders the original equals sign as 5. Replication d is the printed low-minus-medium contrast. Replication Table 4 also supplies a calculated original d; this was not substituted for the statistic printed in the original paper. Replication condition sample sizes are retained separately as printed, rather than substituting the full recruited N.
